title: Review shared concurrency, queue, subprocess, lifecycle, and worker module families
scope: Primary ownership for src/shared concurrency, queue, subprocess, lifecycle, lock, worker, and progress helpers assigned to #412 in the shared-module ledger.

summary.overallAssessment: This shared surface contains several of the repo's most correctness-critical runtime helpers. The main risks are not duplication alone; they are policy and mechanism being entangled inside lock ownership, tracked subprocess cleanup, adaptive scheduling, and progress/logging helpers. The strongest cleanup opportunities are splitting the correctness-critical large files while preserving stable facades and removing a few root-level wrappers that are too caller-specific.

runtimeRisks.reason: File locking remains correctness-critical, but constants, timing, info parsing, owner probing, stale cleanup, release errors, and metrics now live in focused leaves behind the acquisition facade; startup-sensitive callers lazy-load lock behavior.
Tracked subprocess cleanup remains correctness-critical; scope propagation, child registration, runtime bookkeeping, and termination flow now live in focused leaves behind the tracking facade.
Subprocess runner behavior remains correctness-critical; async spawn, sync spawn, isolated-node helpers, and subprocess errors are already split behind the runner facade.
Adaptive scheduling remains correctness-critical; signal sampling, surface snapshots, surface decisions, and token scaling are already split behind the adaptive-controller composition layer.

maintainabilityOnlyNotes.reason: This is a useful formatter, but it is bench-specific and should not live in a generic root shared bucket.
This is an embeddings-specific perf-line formatter and is clearer under an embeddings or bench family.
The file is only a re-export of tools/service/queue.js and creates an odd src/shared-to-tools ownership seam.
The helper moved to tools/tui/supervisor/progress-context.js because only supervisor job spawning owns progress-context env propagation.

highestPriorityFollowUps.reason: The acquisition facade now delegates to focused lock constants, timing, info, owner, stale cleanup, release, and metrics leaves; retrieval/build startup paths lazy-load lock behavior and stay under the shared-module performance baseline.
Scope propagation now lives in tracking-scope.js, child registration in tracking-register.js, runtime bookkeeping in tracking-runtime.js, and termination flow in tracking-terminate.js.
The runner facade now re-exports async runner, sync runner, isolated-node helpers, and subprocess errors from focused leaves.
The root facade has been removed. Shared progress runtime behavior lives in src/shared/progress-runtime.js; supervisor-only context env propagation moved to tools/tui/supervisor/progress-context.js.
Signal sampling, adaptive surface snapshots, per-surface scaling decisions, and token adjustment policy already live in focused adaptive-controller leaves.
The generic src/shared queue alias has been removed; tools/service/queue.js remains the canonical service queue owner.
